name: verify_otp_auth
description: verify_otp_auth: Verify a one-time passcode that the caller reads from their SMS. Returns authenticated: true on success, or a failure if the code does not match.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP048271

otp_code.description: The 6-digit one-time passcode read by the caller. Example: 483920
